RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel hiring a female candidate is not evidence of sex discrimination. Leadership positions like Head of Risk Modelling often prioritize regulatory affairs expertise, executive communication, and stakeholder management alongside technical qualifications. 

Accusing the panel of bias without concrete evidence will likely damage your professional reputation and burn bridges in a specialized industry. Additionally, a two-week turnaround for executive interview feedback is standard corporate practice. 

Instead of raising gender, follow up politely on your feedback request. Frame your inquiry around constructive insights on how to broaden your regulatory and leadership profile for future executive opportunities.
